name: folding easel
look: A folding field easel of pale ash, three legs bound with brass wing nuts, the wood paint-smeared and rubbed dark where hands hold it, strapped with a cracked leather strap.

name: leather satchel
look: A worn brown leather satchel with a buckled flap, scuffed pale at the corners, flecked with dried paint, hanging from a long strap.

name: primed wooden boards
look: Small flat panels of planed limewood, a hand span wide, primed with chalky white gesso on one side, bare wood on the back.

name: sketchbook pages
look: Loose leaves of rough cream paper held in a soft leather cover tied with a cord, edges dog-eared and smudged with charcoal.

name: willow charcoal sticks
look: Thin black sticks of willow charcoal, snapped to different lengths, wrapped in a scrap of oiled cloth.

name: brushes
look: Hog-bristle and squirrel-hair brushes on stained wooden handles, bound with twine where the ferrules would be, bristles splayed from use.

name: yellow ochre cakes
look: Small dry cakes of earthy yellow-brown pigment in a twist of paper.

name: raw umber cakes
look: Small dry cakes of dull brown earth pigment in a twist of paper.

name: verdigris
look: A pinch of blue-green copper pigment in a stoppered clay pot.

name: madder red
look: Deep rose-red lake pigment in a stoppered clay pot.

name: lead white
look: Heavy chalky white pigment in a stoppered clay pot.

name: lamp black
look: Fine soft black soot pigment in a small tin.

name: linseed oil
look: A small stoppered flask of golden linseed oil, its glass smeared with fingerprints; each count is one day's mixing.

name: rags
look: Torn strips of old linen, stiff with dried paint in every colour.

name: silver pennies
look: Worn silver pennies in a small drawstring purse.
